title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: restart

thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 2 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the changing ending presentation and praised the ending song and its visual concept.
Some viewers found the character designs, personalities, and voice performances appealing.
A few commenters were intrigued by the premise and ongoing mysteries but remained cautious about whether the cast would receive enough development.
Some viewers felt the series was difficult to enjoy and less immediately engaging than the previous season.
One reaction suggested that the survival-game premise now feels less fresh because similar shows have become common.
